title: Deadline and Ghost
author: Edmund Vasquez
blurb: Mirabel Whitlock, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
